Class SysMLImage

java.lang.Object
sysmlinjava.common.SysMLAnything
sysmlinjava.occurrences.SysMLOccurrence
sysmlinjava.items.SysMLItem
sysmlinjava.metadata.SysMLMetadata
sysmlinjava.metadata.SysMLImage
public final class SysMLImage extends SysMLMetadata
SysMLinJava's representation of the SysML image metadata. SysMLImage is a specialized type of SysMLMetadata that is used for the attributes of the SysMLIcon. It consists of optional binary data for the image, optional location URI for the image file, optional encoding definition, and optional mime type of the image.

  • Field Details

    • content

      public Optional<String> content
      Binary data for the image according to the given MIME type, encoded as given by the encoding.

    • encoding

      public Optional<String> encoding
      Describes how characters in the content are to be decoded into binary data. At least "base64", "hex", "identify", and "JSONescape" shall be supported.

    • location

      public Optional<String> location
      A URI for the location of a resource containing the image content, as an alternative for embedding it in the content

    • mimeType

      public Optional<String> mimeType
      The MIME type according to which the content should be interpreted.
